audit.whatIsWrong: The Level-1 row read 'Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds' while the side column correctly gives level 1 to Akshan — the prose argued the opposite of the rating.
audit.why: Avengerang is 850 range on a 9s rank-1 cooldown and Seismic Shard is 625; Malphite cannot win a level-1 poke exchange. The lane is: concede the pre-6 window, take it back on Unstoppable Force and armour.
audit.corrected: phases[0].why now states the range and cooldown gap and the actual instruction (last-hit at max range behind Granite Shield).

audit.why: Spikes are placed correctly: Akshan levels 1-3 and again at 6 with Comeuppance, Malphite at 6 and on the first armour item. Content spikes[] and the level chart agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing was described only as a 'dash + camera swing escape'. Two hard conditions Riot states in the ability text were never mentioned: it must be fired into terrain, and he is knocked off it on collision with a champion.
audit.why: That turns his escape from unavoidable into positional. Fought away from walls, Heroic Swing has no anchor; fought near them, standing in his swing arc ends it. It is also 18s at rank 1, the longest cooldown in his laning kit, which is the real engage window.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and content spikes[1] now state the terrain requirement, the champion-collision cancel and the 18s number.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 text claimed Unstoppable Force 'ignores his camouflage repositioning'. Camouflage behaviour and reveal ranges are not in Riot's ability text and I could not verify the claim from the kit data.
audit.why: The verifiable interaction is stronger anyway: the knockup ends Heroic Swing, and champion collision knocks him off the rope regardless of who lands it.
audit.corrected: Replaced the camouflage claim in content spikes[1].text with the collision and knockup interaction.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Akshan contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Avengerang is 850 range on a 9s cooldown and your Q is 625 — you cannot win the poke, so last-hit at max range behind Granite Shield.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 and it must be hooked into terrain — away from walls he has no escape. Colliding with a champion knocks him off it. - Avengerang: 9s at rank 1. - Comeuppance: 100s. - Unstoppable Force: 130s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 18s at rank 1, it needs a wall to anchor to, and champion collision knocks him off mid-swing.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: He hooks it into terrain — fight in open lane and it has nothing to anchor on.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force flips the lane — your R catches him mid-E-swing and ignores his camouflage repositioning for your first real kill threat.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force flips the lane — the knockup ends Heroic Swing mid-flight and colliding with him knocks him off the rope, your first real kill threat.

notes: I removed the claim that Unstoppable Force 'ignores his camouflage repositioning' — camouflage reveal rules are not in Riot's ability text and the kit file's needsResearch block is empty, so I could not verify it. The kit file flags Malphite's Q and E as 'grounding'; Riot's descriptions say slow and attack-speed slow only, so I never claimed Malphite can ground Heroic Swing.
